title: Immersion Hours by Media Type
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:immersion media_type=* hours=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(hours) as metric by _time media_type
| sort 0 _time media_type
description: Trends monthly immersion hours by media type for immersion practice.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether immersion practice are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `media_type` on `language:immersion` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly immersion hours.
visualization: Line chart of monthly immersion hours by media type.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how immersion hours changes month by month for each media type so you can see whether immersion practice are heading the right way.
